summary: Regression check after moving demo data into MongoDB fixtures. Everything requested passes. Backend: a new test_fixtures_demo_content.py passes 7/7. It covers: demo-accounts returns 6 accounts from the fixture; demo-content returns fixture_id, 3 documents with dates filled in, pdf meta, customer_change and 9 tour steps; a registered organizer with a real job gets 404; a request with no login gets 401; seed_fixtures.py --db assemble_scratch loads the fixture and can be run twice safely; changing Redwood's price and a document label in test_database.fixtures shows up in a fresh visitor's intake and in demo-content; with an empty fixtures collection, demo login still works and the fixture is loaded again. test_database.fixtures was restored and checked equal to the JSON file, and the scratch DB was dropped. The existing tests (test_assemble_flow, test_extract_summary, test_pdf_upload) pass 56/56. Frontend (Playwright, desktop): all 5 sample buttons take their labels from the DB and fill kind, label and date. The 3 text samples contain no leftover {placeholders}, and the PDF and scanned PDF are attached as files. The tour loads 9 steps from the DB. Steps 3-8 'Do it for me' give: $156k fails capacity in weeks 1 and 2; $168k passes at 4/4/4; links marked as shared; 6/4/2 preview; Dogwood repair $172k passes, with Alder changed, Birch and Cedar unchanged, Dogwood new; revised terms selected (v3). Minimize collapses the card to a 49px header that shows the step title, and expands it again. customer-change-sample-button fills the note plus S09->1 and S10->1. review-back-to-organizer-button returns to /project as the organizer. A drop event outside the read form has defaultPrevented=true for both dragover and drop, and the URL does not change. No page errors.

minor.issue: It uses str.format_map on fixture text, so a literal '{' or '}' in a future fixture document gives KeyError/ValueError, which becomes a 500 on /demo-content and /sample-pdf. Consider string.Template or replacing only known keys.

Without --replace, the upsert uses $set, so keys removed from the JSON stay in the DB. Startup only loads when the collection is empty, so edits to the JSON never reach an existing DB unless someone runs seed_fixtures.py. This is by design, but worth documenting.

issues: read-date-input uses the native browser date picker (type=date) instead of the shadcn calendar.

The demo content is cached in a module variable, and clearDemoContent() is exported but never called. After 'Reset my demo copy' (start_date is recalculated as next Monday) or after signing out and signing in as another visitor in the same tab, the sample documents and dates can be stale until a full page reload. Call clearDemoContent on logout and on reset.

action_items: Optional: call clearDemoContent() on logout and after demo reset
Optional: make fixtures.render tolerant of literal braces
Optional: replace the native date input with the shadcn calendar
critical_code_review_comments: The window-level dragover/drop guard is only added in ProjectSheet.jsx. Other routes (Review, Summary, Login) still let a dropped file navigate away. Low impact.
get_fixture hits the DB on every demo login (demo_key_for) and on every demo-content/sample-pdf request. Fine at this scale.
The 404 for registered organizers comes from two places: with no job, 'No job yet' from get_project; with a job, the synthetic check. Both are 404.
seed_data_creation: Several demo visitor sandboxes (fx-<hex>), one registered test_fx_<hex>@example.com user with a TEST job. test_database.fixtures was temporarily modified and then restored (checked equal to the JSON file). The assemble_scratch DB was created and then dropped.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_fixtures_demo_content.py changes the shared test_database.fixtures and restores it in a finally block. Run it with -n 0 (xdist in parallel caused a label assertion to see the TEST label). The regression suite takes about 60s with -n 0 and makes about 3 LLM calls (in test_pdf_upload). Sheet JSON: /api/project -> sheet.intake (not sheet.project.intake).
